mapper.select: select TAB_NUM tabNum, TAB_NAME tabName, TEMP_PATH tempPath, TEMP_NAME tempName, TEMP_PRAMS tempPrams from DIS_POI_TAB where 1=1 and STATUS ='E' and TAB_NUM = #{tabNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select ID id, TAB_NUM tabNum, SUB_NAME subName, SUB_TYPE subType, SUB_FORM_TYPE subFormType, SUB_WIDTH subWidth, SUB_TMP_TYPE subTmpType, SUB_CHART_TYPE subChartType, SUB_DEFUALT subDefualt, SUB_CHART_CONF subChartConf from DIS_POI_SUB where 1=1 and STATUS ='E' and TAB_NUM = #{tabNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select ID id, POI_ID poiId, POI_TYPE poiType, POI_ORDER poiOrder, POI_SQL poiSql from DIS_POI_QUERY where 1=1 and POI_ID = #{poiId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and POI_TYPE = #{poiType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by POI_ORDER asc
